title: SpaceX Pursues $40B Debt Sale to Buy Nvidia AI Chips

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Apollo is coordinating a financing effort for a private aerospace firm to acquire artificial intelligence hardware. SpaceX is looking to raise $40B through the sale of debt to purchase chips from Nvidia, according to the Financial Times. This capital injection is intended to expand the company's AI compute capacity as it scales its digital infrastructure.

The shift toward debt financing allows the firm to grow its technological capabilities without issuing additional shares and diluting current ownership. The company aims to use this increased capacity to create a new revenue stream by integrating AI compute with its existing operations in satellite connectivity, power, and launch services.
